item.title: Inside the daring rescue of airman behind enemy lines: How CIA assisted with 'deception campaign'
item.summary: U.S. military rescued a seriously wounded F-15 crew member from deep inside Iran's mountains in what Trump called an amazing show of bravery and talent.

item.title: Yankees legend Reggie Jackson criticizes Pete Hegseth's leadership amid Iran conflict
item.summary: Baseball Hall of Famer Reggie Jackson slammed Pete Hegseth on X over shaking up Army leadership during the ongoing military operation in Iran.

item.title: Trump calls rescue of downed Air Force airman an 'Easter Miracle'
item.summary: President Donald Trump praised the rescue of a downed U.S. airman in Iran as an “Easter Miracle," calling the mission one of the most daring operations in American military history.

item.title: Trump vows US will strike Iran’s power plants, bridges if Strait of Hormuz is not reopened
item.summary: President Donald Trump issues a profanity-laced deadline to Iran, threatening to strike power plants and bridges Tuesday if the Strait of Hormuz isn't reopened.

item.title: Android flaw lets hackers unlock phones in under a minute
item.summary: Researchers say a serious Android vulnerability affecting certain MediaTek processors could let attackers bypass your lock screen and steal data.

item.title: RFK Jr, EPA chief 'declare war' on microplastics amid growing evidence of health risks
item.summary: RFK Jr. and the EPA head "declare war" on microplastics, adding them to the drinking water contaminants list and launching new health studies.

item.title: Tony D'Angelo stands tall as NXT champion after brutal four-way match at Stand & Deliver
item.summary: Tony D'Angelo won the NXT Championship at Stand & Deliver, defeating Joe Hendry, Ethan Page and Ricky Saints in a brutal fatal four-way match.

item.title: Trump admin urges restoring ballroom construction in emergency motion: 'Time is of the essence'
item.summary: Trump administration files emergency motion to overturn a judge's ruling halting White House ballroom construction, citing security and safety concerns.

item.title: Surging UK Green Party pushes church-state split, critics warn of break from Britain’s Christian roots
item.summary: Critics slam the Green Party's vow to separate the Church of England from the state, calling it a direct assault on the nation's Christian heritage.

item.title: Hungry peacock taps on windows for food, helps himself to fruit and peanuts in neighborhood homes
item.summary: A stray peacock named Pete has apparently settled in on a quiet street, approaching homes and pecking at windows in search of food from charmed locals.
